correctness.rationale: For Fibonacci words W_j=W_(j-1) W_(j-2) the near-commutation W_j W_(j-1) and W_(j-1) W_j agrees through the first F_(j+1)-2 positions and differs in the final two, by induction. The infinite Fibonacci word starts W_k W_(k-1) W_k, so comparison with shift F_k gives first mismatch at n=F_(k+1)-2 for all k>=4. This nonzero first mismatch has canonical Zeckendorf word length k-1. Taking an arbitrary s-state MSD DFAO for the shift, product with the 2-state last-digit Fibonacci DFAO and a 4-state valid Zeckendorf recognizer yields a <=8s-state DFA accepting exactly canonical first differences. Shortest accepted word length k-1 forces >=k distinct prefix states, so 8s>=k. The published O(log F_k)=O(k) MSD upper bound gives Theta(k). Independent morphic-word checks corroborated first disagreement for k=4..16, not an infinite proof.
